text: What happens when a friendzone guy thinks that he actually has a girlfriend? Another crazy question. Hey man, I've been struggling for a bit. Me and my girlfriend. Well, technically she is not my girlfriend, but we've been together for 3 months, and ever since we talk she always been ignoring my texts for 4 hours or more. Man, what does it mean technically she is not my girlfriend? Well, then why do you call her your girlfriend if she is not your girlfriend? So the way it looks to me, just from this couple of sentences, you are talking to this girl for 3 months, not moving through any stages. I doubt that you kissed and or had sex, but you imagine in your mind that she is your girlfriend. But for her, you are just some guy. Maybe a friend. So you are friendzone, man. And it's been bothering me by a lot, and I really do want to tell her about it, but I don't want forcing her to change just for me. And after graduation, I'll ask confess to her, but that one problem hasn't disappeared yet. And I also feel like she just talks to me whenever she feels like it, like I'm just her second option. Even though we are not technically a couple yet, I still give her reassurance that I love her, even though she doesn't do that to me. I feel like a clown doing that. You are a clown, man. You are not her boyfriend. Probably not even a second option. In a way, you are nobody to her. So why would she text nobody, talk to nobody, tell nobody something? You are living in a fantasy world, thinking that you matter to her. Once again, guys, if you do stupid actions, you get stupid consequences. It seems like instead of moving through stages, asking her out, kissing her, spending time with her, and then sleeping with her, preferably many times, you just became a tag along who follows that girl around and tell her, I love you. My advice to you, forget about this girl. It seems like you have messed up way too much in this situation, made all mistakes possible to the point of no return. So it would be very difficult, if not impossible, to change anything. Your best option is to realize your mistakes and start having stories with other women, where you hopefully will not make the same mistakes. Thanks a lot, my name is Ilyas Abdullin, and bye!
